buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic Buyer Organization specific Integrity Pact shall have to be complied by all bidders. Bidders shall have to upload scanned copy of signed integrity pact as per Buyer organizations policy along with bid. Click here to view the file 2. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 50 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 50% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms.

3. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing and Commissioning of Goods 4. Inspection Nominated Inspection Agency: On behalf of the Buyer organization, any one of the following Inspection Agency would be conducting inspection of stores before acceptance: Pre-dispatch Inspection at Seller Premises (applicable only if pre-dispatch inspection clause has been selected in ATC): Board of Officers as nominated by BRO Post Receipt Inspection at consignee site before acceptance of stores: Board of Officers as nominated by BRO 5. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 6. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses PQ CRITERIA/OTHER TERMS & CONDITIONS. 1. (a) Performance Evaluation of Offered equipment. If the offered equipment is not trial evaluated in BRO. The bidder must be an OEM and must have s old in market a minimum 02 Nos of vehicle of similar or higher capacity in last three years. Copies of related Supply Orders and Performance certificates, in support of these will be submitted by the bidder. BRO reserves the right to conduct limited ‘No Cost No Commitment’ basis performance tria ls for a period of 50 hours operation at a mutually agreed project location including Vendor Premis es. OR If the offered equipment is trial evaluated in BRO and is not in service in BRO / Indian Army. The offered vehicle has been trial evaluated and found successful in BRO/has been found qualified in staff evaluation for procurement by Indian Army. Documentary proof in support of this be enclo sed. OR If the offered equipment is in service in BRO. The offered vehicle is presently in service with BRO a nd its Performance is Satisfactory. Performance of equipment already inducted in BRO shall be eval uated internally by E4 (Repair)/TA Dte/HQ DGBR. In case found unsatisfactory, the bid of concerne d bidder shall be rejected. In this regard the decision of BRO is final. (b) Experience Criteria : The Bidder i.e. OEM (themselves or through resellers(s)) should have r egularly, manufactured and supplied same or similar Category Products for 3 years before the bid o pening date. Copies of relevant contracts to be submitted along with bid in support of having suppl ied a definite quantity during each of the year. 2. Commissioning of Vehicle (By Seller). The vehicle shall be commissioned by the Seller within a maximum period of 30 days from the date of receipt of communication from the consignee confirming that the vehicle is ready for commissioning. For any delay in commissioning of such equipment beyond 30 days of receipt of co mmunication, a penalty @ 0.10% of the contract price per day per vehicle, subject to a maximum of 10% of the value of non-commissioned vehicle, shall be levied on the Seller. This amount shall be re covered either from any payment due to the SELLER or from the Performance Bank Guarantee, whic hever is applicable.

3. Warranty (i) The SELLER warrants that the goods supplied under this contract conform to technical specifi cations prescribed and shall perform according to the said Technical Specifications. (ii) The SELLER warrants for a period of 12 months or 1000 operational hours from the date of c ommissioning, whichever is earlier, that the goods/stores supplied under this contract and each co mponent used in the manufacture thereof shall be free from all types of defects/failures. (iii) Idling charges will be applicable for the period of defects. 4. Resources for providing spares & consumables for maintenance up to 10 years: The bidder should have adequate facilities pan India to carry out after sales service at various consignees for a total period of 10 (Ten) years including Guarantee/Warranty period of 01(One) year and 09 (Nine) years thereafter in ter ms of supply of spares. 5. Idling Charges. In case of defects developing during the warranty period, if the vehicle is not put back in running c ondition (by Seller) within a period of maximum of 21 days from the date of issue of notification, failing whi ch the seller shall be liable to be charged an idling cost for the entire delay duration (Incl 21 days) @ INR R s. 17436.00 (Rupees Seventeen Thousand Four Hundred Thirty Six Only) per day subject to a maximum of 5% of the contract value, shall be levied on the Seller. If there is further such delay after reaching this limit , the Procuring Entity shall be entitled to encashment of the whole of Performance Bank Guarantee, beside s recording the adverse performance of the contractor for future tenders. 6. Price to be quoted shall inclusive of GST & freight charges. 7. This bid is reserved for OEM only. 8. Engineering Support Package. (i) Tools. One set of tools required for undertaking regular and periodical maintenance, shall be provided along with the each vehicle, on FREE OF COST. (ii) Technical Literature: All Technical Literatures (hard copy in English) described below shall b e supplied by the Seller on FREE OF COST along with each vehicles: (aa) Operation, Repair and maintenance manual for both engine and vehicle. (ab) Workshop manual for both engine and vehicle.(ac) Illustrated parts catalogue for both en gine and vehicle. (ad) Illustrated list of Special Maintenance Tools, if any. (ae) Lubrication charts for complete vehicle. (af) In addition, Four sets (Two sets in hard copy and two sets in soft (copy) of aforesaid liter ature to be handed over to HQ DGBR / E4Tech. 9. First-Aid Kit: The equipment shall be supplied with one complete first-aid kit, securely housed in a suitable, clearly identified container and containing the prescribed first-aid materials, including sterilised dressings, gauze, adhesive and waterproof plasters, bandages and other essential first-aid supplies, as a pplicable. The kit shall comply with the applicable statutory requirements and relevant current standards , wherever applicable. All sterile and other time-sensitive items supplied with the First-Aid Kit shall have a t least 90% of their total shelf life remaining as on the date of delivery of the equipment. 10. The bidder shall submit a certificate on compliance of Rule 144 (xi) of GFR 2017 as per Ministry of Finance, Department of Expenditure , Public Procurement Division vide their order Nos dated 23 Jul 2020 and its subsequent Procurement Orders 2 and 3 dated 23 and 24 Jul 2020 vide their File No 06 / 18 / 201 9. Model Certificate enclosed as Appendix ‘A’

Appendix ‘A’ To Dir E3ES, Headquarter Directorate General of Border Roads Seema Sadak Bhawan New Delhi- 110010. THIS IS TO CERTIFY THAT 1. I (Bidder) certify that I have read that ‘‘File No 06/18/2019 – PPD by Ministry of Finance, Departmen t of Expenditure, Public Procurement Division (Attached) Subject: Insertion of rule 144 (xi) in the GFR 2017’ ’ regarding restrictions on procurement from a bidder of a country which shares land border with India and Procurement Order dated 23 and 24 Jul 2020. 2. “I have read the clause regarding restrictions on procurement from a bidder of a country which sha res a land border with India; I certify that this vendor/bidder is not from such a country or, if from such a c ountry, has been registered with the Competent Authority. I hereby certify that this vender/bidder fulfills al l requirements in this regard and is eligible to be considered for procurement on GeM. (Where applicable, evidence of valid registration by the Competent Authority shall be attached).’’ Stamped and Signed by Authorised Signatory on behalf of the Firm With Name, Appointment, Name of Firm, Phone No. and Date .
